metadata.generation_note: Converted trajectory-derived WebShop strategies into state-aware experiences grounded in WebShop observations and admissible search/click actions.

experiences.trigger: the model is about to act and the prompt shows the current admissible actions
experiences.recommended_action: emit exactly one listed search[...] or click[...] action inside the action tag; replace the search placeholder with a concrete query
experiences.avoid_action: invent a clickable label, copy search[<your query>] literally, or emit multiple actions
experiences.expected_effect: the environment accepts the action and the step advances
experiences.retrieval_text: WebShop exact admissible action action tag concrete search query valid click label

experiences.trigger: the current page has a search bar and no useful product results are displayed yet
experiences.recommended_action: search for the product type plus the two or three hardest identifying constraints, using short marketplace-style keywords
experiences.avoid_action: paste the full natural-language instruction or omit the product type
experiences.expected_effect: results remain broad enough to contain candidates while reflecting the mandatory attributes
experiences.retrieval_text: initial search bar product type hard constraints concise keyword query

experiences.trigger: search results are irrelevant, empty, or dominated by the wrong product category
experiences.recommended_action: issue a revised search that keeps the product noun, removes low-value modifiers, and substitutes one useful synonym or defining attribute
experiences.avoid_action: repeat the identical query or make the query longer with every instruction word
experiences.expected_effect: the next result set changes and has a better chance of containing the requested category
experiences.retrieval_text: irrelevant empty wrong category results refine search remove modifiers synonym

experiences.trigger: a results page lists several clickable products
experiences.recommended_action: compare visible titles and prices against the product type, hard attributes, and budget, then click the strongest plausible candidate
experiences.avoid_action: click the first result solely because one keyword matches or choose an item already visibly over budget
experiences.expected_effect: product-page visits are spent on candidates that can satisfy the instruction
experiences.retrieval_text: results page scan product titles prices hard constraints click best candidate

experiences.trigger: the current observation is a product detail page
experiences.recommended_action: verify product identity and visible hard constraints before choosing options; inspect description or features only for required attributes not already evidenced
experiences.avoid_action: buy immediately from a partial title match or spend steps inspecting irrelevant details
experiences.expected_effect: wrong-category and unsupported-attribute purchases are rejected early
experiences.retrieval_text: product detail verify identity hard constraints description features before buy

experiences.trigger: the instruction requires a color, size, style, flavor, pack count, or capacity and matching option buttons are visible
experiences.recommended_action: click every required option value exactly once and confirm the selected state in the next observation
experiences.avoid_action: click buy now while a mandatory option is unselected or choose a near-match option
experiences.expected_effect: the purchased variant matches the requested configuration
experiences.retrieval_text: mandatory variant option select exact color size style flavor pack capacity before buy

experiences.trigger: buy now is admissible and the candidate appears relevant
experiences.recommended_action: buy only after checking product type, all explicitly requested attributes, selected variants, and the displayed price against the budget
experiences.avoid_action: treat buy now availability as proof that the task is satisfied
experiences.expected_effect: the terminal purchase maximizes attribute match instead of ending on a partial candidate
experiences.retrieval_text: buy now final checklist category attributes variants price budget

experiences.trigger: a product violates a hard constraint or lacks evidence for a mandatory attribute
experiences.recommended_action: return to the results with click[< prev] or click[back to search], then inspect a different candidate or refine the query
experiences.avoid_action: select variants or buy a known mismatch because steps were already spent on it
experiences.expected_effect: remaining steps are redirected toward a feasible item
experiences.retrieval_text: product hard constraint mismatch over budget absent feature back results reject candidate

experiences.trigger: the same page or product has been revisited without revealing new constraint evidence
experiences.recommended_action: stop repeating the navigation loop and choose a new product, a new results page, or a revised search query
experiences.avoid_action: alternate indefinitely between description, features, and previous page or reopen the same rejected item
experiences.expected_effect: the limited step budget covers new candidates rather than duplicate states
experiences.retrieval_text: repeated page product navigation loop identical observation choose new candidate query

experiences.trigger: the current results page contains no good candidate and next page is admissible
experiences.recommended_action: click next once to inspect unseen results when the query is sound; refine the search instead if the whole category is wrong
experiences.avoid_action: page through many uniformly irrelevant results or bounce between next and previous
experiences.expected_effect: pagination is used only when it expands a promising candidate set
experiences.retrieval_text: results pagination next unseen candidates relevant query avoid next previous loop

experiences.trigger: the instruction asks for clothing with gender, material, sleeve, fit, pattern, color, or size constraints
experiences.recommended_action: search using garment type plus the rarest material or design attribute, then verify size and color as selectable options on the detail page
experiences.avoid_action: assume every title match offers the requested size or color
experiences.expected_effect: the selected garment matches both descriptive and variant constraints
experiences.retrieval_text: apparel garment gender material sleeve fit pattern exact size color option

experiences.trigger: a clothing product page has description or features links and the requested fabric or design is not proven by the title
experiences.recommended_action: open description or features once, verify the exact fabric/design wording, then return and configure the variant
experiences.avoid_action: infer cotton, sleeve type, or fit from an image-like title alone
experiences.expected_effect: hidden apparel specifications are checked before purchase
experiences.retrieval_text: apparel hidden fabric design verify description features return configure variant

experiences.trigger: the instruction requests footwear with a numeric size, color, material, or use case
experiences.recommended_action: search by footwear type and use case/material, then select the exact size and color buttons before buying
experiences.avoid_action: encode every size spelling into the search or assume the default variant is correct
experiences.expected_effect: the shoe candidate remains searchable while the purchased variant meets fit constraints
experiences.retrieval_text: footwear shoe boot size color material use case select exact variant

experiences.trigger: the task requests a home item with dimensions, room use, material, pattern, or color
experiences.recommended_action: search by item type and distinctive material/pattern, then verify dimensions in the title, features, or variant controls
experiences.avoid_action: treat approximate dimensions or a similar room category as an exact match
experiences.expected_effect: the home item satisfies physical-size and design requirements
experiences.retrieval_text: home decor rug curtain pillow dimensions material pattern color verify exact

experiences.trigger: the task contains compatibility, connector, model, capacity, or performance requirements
experiences.recommended_action: include the device/model and defining compatibility term in the search, then verify connector, capacity, and supported model in features before purchase
experiences.avoid_action: buy an accessory based only on a generic product-type match
experiences.expected_effect: the electronic item is technically compatible with the requested use
experiences.retrieval_text: electronics compatibility device model connector capacity performance verify features

experiences.trigger: the task requests a bag, wallet, jewelry, hat, belt, or other accessory with material, dimensions, or style constraints
experiences.recommended_action: search the exact accessory type with its most distinctive attribute and verify dimensions/material in features when absent from the title
experiences.avoid_action: accept a visually similar accessory from a neighboring category
experiences.expected_effect: the candidate matches accessory category and construction details
experiences.retrieval_text: accessories bag wallet jewelry exact category material dimensions style verify

experiences.trigger: the task requests beauty or health goods with formulation, scent, body area, count, or skin/hair-use constraints
experiences.recommended_action: search by product type plus the defining formulation/use term and verify count, scent, and intended use in features
experiences.avoid_action: substitute a related cosmetic or infer formulation from brand language
experiences.expected_effect: the selected product has the requested formulation and intended use
experiences.retrieval_text: beauty health skincare formulation scent body area pack count verify features

experiences.trigger: the instruction specifies a maximum price and visible candidate prices differ
experiences.recommended_action: discard candidates whose displayed price exceeds the cap and recheck the price after selecting required variants
experiences.avoid_action: round down an over-budget price or rely on a search-result price after the variant changes
experiences.expected_effect: the purchased configuration remains within the explicit budget
experiences.retrieval_text: budget maximum price under cap reject over budget recheck variant price

experiences.trigger: the instruction includes several independent required attributes
experiences.recommended_action: maintain a checklist separating identity, descriptive features, variant selections, and price; require evidence for every mandatory item before buying
experiences.avoid_action: let one strong attribute match compensate for a missing hard constraint
experiences.expected_effect: candidate evaluation follows the full conjunction of requirements
experiences.retrieval_text: multi attribute checklist identity features variants price all mandatory conjunction

experiences.trigger: the results show both a plausible exact-category item and loosely related sponsored or accessory items
experiences.recommended_action: prefer the title whose head noun is the requested product and whose qualifiers cover hard constraints
experiences.avoid_action: choose an accessory, refill, replacement part, or bundle when the task asks for the main product
experiences.expected_effect: the agent opens the correct product category
experiences.retrieval_text: mixed search results exact product head noun avoid accessory refill replacement bundle

experiences.trigger: description or features subpage is open and contains the evidence needed to judge the candidate
experiences.recommended_action: record whether each requested attribute is supported, then click previous exactly once to return to the product page
experiences.avoid_action: click buy now from the subpage if unavailable or reopen the same subpage without a new question
experiences.expected_effect: evidence is retained while navigation returns to variant selection and purchase controls
experiences.retrieval_text: description features subpage record evidence click previous return product page

experiences.trigger: several option groups are visible and one required value has already been selected
experiences.recommended_action: preserve the confirmed selection and click the exact value in each remaining required group before buying
experiences.avoid_action: toggle the same selected value repeatedly or choose an unrequested default in another group
experiences.expected_effect: all required option groups reach a stable selected state
experiences.retrieval_text: variant selection preserve selected option complete remaining groups avoid toggle

experiences.trigger: the title contains marketing language but not an explicit requested technical or material attribute
experiences.recommended_action: treat the attribute as unverified and inspect features or description for direct evidence
experiences.avoid_action: convert vague terms such as premium, natural, compatible, or professional into proof of a hard constraint
experiences.expected_effect: purchases rely on explicit evidence rather than marketing inference
experiences.retrieval_text: marketing language not evidence verify explicit technical material attribute features description

experiences.trigger: a previous candidate failed only one constraint while its title revealed a better search term
experiences.recommended_action: return to search and reuse the useful product term while replacing the failed attribute with the exact required value
experiences.avoid_action: restart with an unrelated broad query or reopen the rejected candidate
experiences.expected_effect: the next search exploits information learned from the near-match
experiences.retrieval_text: near match failed one constraint refine query useful title term exact required value

experiences.trigger: the remaining step budget is small and a fully verified candidate is available
experiences.recommended_action: complete any still-missing mandatory variant selection and click buy now without unnecessary navigation
experiences.avoid_action: continue exploring marginal alternatives after all hard constraints are satisfied
experiences.expected_effect: the task terminates successfully before the step limit
experiences.retrieval_text: low remaining steps verified candidate finish variants buy now avoid extra exploration
